title: WebChain: A Large-Scale Human-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Web Interaction Traces
authors_zh: Sicheng Fan、Rui Wan、Yifei Leng、Gaoning Liang、Li Ling、Yanyi Shang、Dehan Kong
paper_type_zh: 真实网页人类轨迹数据集与 agent 训练配方
best_for_zh: 关注网页 agent、多模态轨迹、GUI grounding、长程规划，以及开放发布中许可、隐私与可重放性审计的研究者
one_line: Releases 31,725 human-verified live-web trajectories with 317,993 visually, structurally, and action-aligned steps, plus separate grounding and planning recipes, under a gated academic license.
WebChain 发布 31,725 条人工核验的真实网页轨迹，包含 317,993 个视觉、结构与动作对齐的步骤，并以 gated 学术许可提供 grounding 与长程规划训练材料。
why: For the open-release-recipe track, WebChain makes the training unit and three-stage construction pipeline concrete, but also shows why artifact completeness, success semantics, source rights, privacy evidence, and replay metadata must be audited independently of benchmark gains.
inclusion_reason: WebChain provides an unusually large real-site human trajectory object with step-level visual, structural, and action alignment plus a concrete grounding-versus-planning training recipe, while exposing important licensing, privacy, replay, synthetic-rationale, and release-completeness audit boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Web agents must solve two coupled problems. Locally, they need to map an instruction to the correct interactive element and action in a visually dense page. Across time, they need to preserve intent over a sequence of navigation, typing, filtering, and recovery steps. Data built from static screenshots or synthetic browser rollouts often misses authenticated workflows, dynamic layouts, and the simultaneous pixel, DOM, and action evidence available during real use.

Human demonstrations can cover those states, but a bare action log is insufficient for multimodal training. A reusable step needs the page observation, structural representation, action semantics, grounding target, and its position in the trajectory to refer to the same moment. It also needs an honest success contract: matching a demonstrated coordinate or string is different from proving that the website reached the intended terminal state.

WebChain addresses the collection and training sides together. It asks how to build a large live-web corpus with synchronized visual, structural, and action traces, then how to separate spatial grounding from long-horizon planning during post-training. For this atlas, the central question is not only whether benchmark scores improve, but whether the released object, construction recipe, feedback semantics, rights, and replay requirements are sufficiently explicit for audit and reuse.

网页 agent 必须同时解决两个相互牵连的问题：在单个页面内，它要把指令定位到视觉上密集的正确交互元素与动作；跨越多个步骤时，它又要在导航、输入、筛选和恢复操作中持续保持任务意图。仅由静态截图或合成浏览器 rollout 构成的数据，往往难以覆盖登录后流程、动态布局，以及真实操作时同时存在的像素、DOM 与动作证据。

人类示范可以进入这些状态，但只有动作日志仍不足以训练多模态 agent。可复用的步骤对象应确保页面观察、结构表示、动作语义、grounding 目标及其轨迹位置指向同一时刻，同时还要如实界定成功契约：匹配示范坐标或字符串，并不等于证明网站已达到预期终局。

WebChain 同时处理采集与训练问题：先构建视觉、结构和动作同步的大规模真实网页语料，再在后训练中拆分空间 grounding 与长程规划。对本图谱而言，关键不只是 benchmark 是否上升，还包括发布的数据对象、构造配方、反馈语义、权利边界与重放条件是否足够明确，能否被审计和复用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
WebChain's data unit is a task-conditioned human web trajectory rather than an isolated screenshot-action pair. An unnamed LLM first synthesizes tasks from a functional schema extracted from a target site. Human annotators then execute those tasks on live websites through WebChain Builder. Each step aligns visual state, structural state, and the grounded action; post-processing adds annotations for other interactive elements in the viewport and may add an unnamed-VLM-generated action rationale.

The release reports 31,725 human-verified trajectories, 317,993 steps, and 428 domains. These are different denominators. A trajectory averages 10.02 steps and 1.07 minutes. The Hugging Face artifact exposes raw archives plus two processed views: high-level samples for planning from the instruction, history, and current screenshot, and low-level samples for grounding from the current-step instruction and observation. Full-page screenshot coverage is explicitly partial.

The associated Dual Mid-Training recipe separates spatial grounding from long-horizon planning. The paper studies Spatial-Grounding-oriented RLVR with Visual Grounding Densification, CoT-SFT using 5,000 synthetic-rationale samples, and later Long-Chain-oriented RLVR. The accepted taxonomy for this Card remains sft and agent_training; the RL stages are reported as evidence about the recipe, not used to broaden that canonical field.

The supervision should not be read as a unique gold plan. A human trajectory is one successful-looking route through a non-stationary website, while many alternative element targets, orders, shortcuts, and recovery actions may be valid.

WebChain 的基本数据单元是受任务条件约束的人类网页轨迹，而不是孤立的“截图—动作”对。一个未具名 LLM 先根据从目标网站提取的功能 schema 合成任务，人类标注者再借助 WebChain Builder 在真实在线网站上执行任务。每个步骤同步视觉状态、结构状态与 grounded action；后处理还会标注视口内其他可交互元素，并可加入由未具名 VLM 生成的动作解释。

官方报告 31,725 条人工核验轨迹、317,993 个步骤和 428 个 domain，这三个数字的分母不同。每条轨迹平均 10.02 步、耗时 1.07 分钟。Hugging Face 发布物既有原始归档，也有两种加工视图：高层样本结合指令、历史和当前截图训练规划，低层样本结合当前步骤指令与观察训练 grounding。全页面截图明确只覆盖部分记录。

配套的 Dual Mid-Training 将空间 grounding 与长程规划分开培养。论文研究了结合 Visual Grounding Densification 的 Spatial-Grounding-oriented RLVR、使用 5,000 条合成解释样本的 CoT-SFT，以及后续 Long-Chain-oriented RLVR。本 Card 仍遵守已接受的 sft 与 agent_training 分类边界；RL 阶段仅作为配方证据说明，不用于扩张 canonical 字段。

这些监督不能被理解成唯一 gold plan。人类轨迹只是非平稳网站上的一条看似成功路径，其他元素、顺序、快捷操作和恢复动作同样可能有效。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper describes a three-stage construction pipeline followed by two task-oriented training views.

  1. Static analysis extracts a functional schema for each target website, including domain semantics, available interactions, and logical dependencies such as sort, filter, and conditional constraints. An unnamed LLM conditions on that schema to synthesize simple information-retrieval, multi-constraint navigation, or conditional-dependency tasks. The paper does not disclose the generator model, prompt, temperature, seed, retry policy, or task rejection counts.
  2. Human annotators execute the synthesized tasks on live sites through WebChain Builder. For each action, the logger records complete pre- and post-action DOM snapshots, the action type and arguments, viewport coordinates, target bounding box, XPath, CSS selector, target text, and timestamp. The corpus also carries viewport screenshots, available full-page screenshots, and Accessibility tree snapshots. Recruitment, compensation, annotator training, agreement, and per-trajectory adjudication are unknown.
  3. Contextual enrichment parses all interactive elements in the viewport, not only the selected target, to create dense grounding alternatives and negatives. An unnamed VLM receives the task, prior state/action history, and current GUI state to produce an action-level Chain-of-Thought-style rationale. Because the rationale is synthesized after the action, it is not evidence of the annotator's original reasoning; the model, prompt, sampling, and acceptance procedure are undisclosed.

The official release organizes these objects into raw JSON/image archives and processed Parquet files. processed/high_parquet targets long-horizon planning using the task, history, and current page image; processed/low_parquet targets local grounding and action localization. The repository warns that raw folders need custom parsers and that the release is not one standardized Hugging Face schema. It also states that full-page screenshot coverage is not exhaustive.

Feedback differs by stage. Collection retains trajectories described as human-verified, but the inspected artifacts do not expose a domain-general executable completion predicate or per-trajectory decision log. In training experiments, a scalar step reward combines action-type agreement with action-content agreement: a click matches when its coordinate lies inside the reference target box, while typed text matches when the prediction lexically covers the reference text. This contract measures agreement with recorded behavior; it does not independently query the live environment to prove final task success.

The training scaffold first develops spatial grounding and planning capabilities separately, then applies Long-Chain-oriented RLVR. The paper uses Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B in reported experiments. Exact software versions and a complete runnable training manifest were not found in the author-linked GitHub repository, which contained only documentation and two images when checked.

论文给出三阶段构造流程，之后再形成面向两类任务的训练视图。

  1. 静态分析先提取目标网站的功能 schema，包括 domain 语义、可用交互，以及排序、筛选和条件约束等逻辑依赖。一个未具名 LLM 以此为条件，合成简单信息检索、多约束导航或条件依赖任务。论文没有披露生成模型、prompt、temperature、seed、重试策略和任务拒绝数量。
  2. 人类标注者通过 WebChain Builder 在真实网站上执行合成任务。每次动作都会记录完整的动作前后 DOM、动作类型与参数、视口坐标、目标 bounding box、XPath、CSS selector、目标文本和时间戳；语料还带有视口截图、可用时的全页面截图与 Accessibility tree。标注者招募、报酬、培训、一致性和逐轨迹裁决仍为 unknown。
  3. 上下文增强会解析视口中的全部可交互元素，而不只记录被点击的目标，以构造密集 grounding 候选与负例。另一个未具名 VLM 接收任务、此前状态/动作历史和当前 GUI 状态，生成动作级 Chain-of-Thought 风格解释。由于解释是在动作之后合成的，它不能证明标注者当时的真实推理；所用模型、prompt、采样与接受规则均未披露。

官方发布物将这些对象组织为原始 JSON/图片归档和加工后的 Parquet。processed/high_parquet 使用任务、历史与当前页面图像面向长程规划，processed/low_parquet 面向局部 grounding 与动作定位。仓库明确提示原始目录需要自定义解析器，全部文件并不共享一套标准 Hugging Face schema，而且全页面截图不完整。

不同阶段的反馈含义不同。采集结果被称为“人工核验”，但已检查的材料没有给出跨 domain 的可执行完成谓词或逐轨迹判定日志。训练实验中的标量 step reward 同时考察动作类型与动作内容：点击坐标落入参考目标框即匹配，预测输入文本在词汇上覆盖参考文本即匹配。这一契约衡量的是与记录行为的一致性，并不会独立查询真实环境来证明任务最终完成。

训练 scaffold 先分别建立空间 grounding 与规划能力，再执行 Long-Chain-oriented RLVR。论文实验采用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-7B；但作者链接的 GitHub 仓库在检查时只有说明文档和两张图片，没有精确软件版本或完整可运行训练 manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The CVPR 2026 paper and official Hugging Face card agree on the core scale: 31,725 human-verified trajectories, 317,993 interaction steps, 428 domains, 10.02 steps per trajectory on average, and 1.07 minutes per task on average. The abstract rounds the step count to 318K. The HF file manifest at revision ae99f420a646866fd3f6d70ca5984efa0eca5a77 contains raw JSON and image archives, partial full-page screenshot archives, high-level Parquet, and low-level Parquet; the repository reports a total size of about 837 GB.

The clearest training evidence is controlled within the paper, not a direct quality audit of the release. On WCB-L with Qwen2.5-VL-3B, direct LCRL scores 0.487, adding CoT-SFT scores 0.603, adding SGRL scores 0.629, and combining both scores 0.658. The strongest reported 7B WebChain variant reaches 81.4 in the paper's aggregate public-GUI benchmark table. A matched scaling study uses 4K, 20K, and 150K action-step subsets and reports a positive trend, but the text does not enumerate the plotted scores, so this Card does not manufacture them.

WebChainBench contains 1,200 held-out interaction steps split into short- and long-chain subsets, balanced across short, medium, and long histories. It counts a prediction as correct only when both action type and action behavior match. This is useful evidence for the stated grounding/planning decomposition, but the checked artifacts do not provide a deterministic split manifest, cross-benchmark decontamination report, or proof that every valid alternative action is accepted.

Release evidence narrows the paper's “open-source” language. The Hugging Face repository is publicly visible but manually gated, and WebChain Academic Research License v1.0 grants approved non-commercial academic use while restricting commercial use, substantial redistribution, mirroring, and re-identification. The arXiv v3 links an author repository, but its checked tree contained only README.md, trajectory_info.png, and webchain_table3_benchmark_results.png; no implementation or license file was present. Thus the dataset's gated availability is verified, while an end-to-end code release is not.

The paper states that collection, redaction, and review preserve privacy and that no PII is released. This is recorded as an author claim. No per-record redaction evidence, audit sample, estimated miss rate, consent protocol, or site-level compliance log was available to independently test it.

CVPR 2026 论文与官方 Hugging Face 数据卡对核心规模的描述一致：31,725 条人工核验轨迹、317,993 个交互步骤、428 个 domain，轨迹平均长度 10.02 步，任务平均耗时 1.07 分钟。摘要将步骤数四舍五入为 318K。HF revision ae99f420a646866fd3f6d70ca5984efa0eca5a77 的文件清单包含原始 JSON 与图像归档、部分全页面截图归档、高层 Parquet 和低层 Parquet，仓库标示总规模约 837 GB。

论文内部的受控实验是最清楚的训练证据，但不是对发布数据的直接质量审计。在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 的 WCB-L 上，直接 LCRL 得分 0.487，加入 CoT-SFT 为 0.603，加入 SGRL 为 0.629，两者同时加入为 0.658。论文公开 GUI benchmark 汇总表中，最强的 7B WebChain 变体达到 81.4。等设置 scaling 实验采用 4K、20K 和 150K 个 action-step 子集并报告正相关趋势；正文没有逐一列出图中数值，因此本 Card 不补造分数。

WebChainBench 由 1,200 个 held-out 交互步骤构成，分为短链和长链子集，并在短、中、长历史之间平衡。只有动作类型和具体行为同时匹配才算正确。这支持论文提出的 grounding/规划拆分，但已检查材料没有给出确定性 split manifest、跨 benchmark 去污染报告，也未证明所有替代有效动作都会被接受。

发布证据收窄了论文中的“open-source”表述。Hugging Face 仓库虽然公开可见，却需要人工审批；WebChain Academic Research License v1.0 只授予获批的非商业学术使用，并限制商业使用、大规模再分发、镜像和再识别。arXiv v3 链接了作者仓库，但检查到的树仅有 README.md、trajectory_info.png 和 webchain_table3_benchmark_results.png，没有实现文件或 LICENSE。因此，可以确认 gated 数据发布，不能确认端到端代码发布。

论文声称采集、脱敏和审查保护了隐私，并称发布物不含 PII。本 Card 只把它记录为作者声明，因为没有逐记录脱敏证据、审计样本、漏检率估计、同意协议或逐网站合规日志可供独立检验。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main novelty is the released data object and its scale, not merely the use of human browsing. WebChain synchronizes three views at every action: pixels for visual grounding, HTML/Accessibility structure for semantic localization, and precise action metadata for behavioral supervision. Because the same step remains embedded in a full task trajectory, the object can support both local element selection and long-horizon planning rather than forcing users to choose between screenshot-level and episode-level datasets.

The construction recipe also distinguishes collection from enrichment. Human annotators supply the actual live-site behavior; dense annotations for all visible interactive elements expand spatial supervision; synthetic rationales add a planning-oriented view. Keeping those provenance layers distinct matters, because “human-annotated trajectory” does not mean that every field—especially the Chain-of-Thought-style rationale—is human-authored.

Dual Mid-Training operationalizes that distinction by developing grounding and planning separately before long-chain optimization. Its reported ablations show that spatial initialization and rationale-based SFT have complementary effects on WCB-L. This is a useful recipe-level contribution, but benchmark gains do not certify privacy, task correctness, rights, or the fidelity of individual rationales.

For the open-release-recipe track, WebChain is particularly informative because it combines a high-volume artifact with a concrete pipeline and then exposes a gap between publication language and reusable release conditions: the data is gated under a custom license, raw formats need custom parsing, full-page screenshots are incomplete, and the linked repository is documentation-only at the checked revision.

WebChain 的主要新意在于发布的数据对象及其规模，而不只是“由人浏览网页”。每个动作都同步三种视图：用于视觉 grounding 的像素、用于语义定位的 HTML/Accessibility 结构，以及用于行为监督的精确动作元数据。由于该步骤仍处在完整任务轨迹中，同一对象既可训练局部元素选择，也可训练长程规划，不必在截图级与 episode 级数据之间二选一。

构造配方还把实际采集与后续增强分开。人类标注者提供真实网站上的行为，视口内全部可交互元素的密集标注扩展空间监督，合成解释则提供面向规划的另一种视图。保持这些 provenance 层次非常重要：“人工标注轨迹”不等于每个字段都由人编写，尤其不包括 Chain-of-Thought 风格解释。

Dual Mid-Training 将这一分工落实为先分别培养 grounding 与规划，再做长链优化。消融结果表明，空间初始化和基于解释的 SFT 对 WCB-L 有互补作用。这是有价值的配方证据，但 benchmark 增益不能认证隐私、任务正确性、内容权利或单条解释的忠实度。

对开放发布配方 track 而言，WebChain 的价值还在于同时呈现了大体量 artifact、清晰 pipeline 与发布条件之间的落差：数据采用自定义 gated 许可，原始格式需要自写解析器，全页面截图不完整，作者链接仓库在检查 revision 上也只有说明材料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The success contract is under-specified. “Human-verified” does not reveal how completion was judged across 428 domains, how disagreements or failed attempts were handled, or whether a reviewer replayed each trajectory. The experimental coordinate-in-box and lexical-coverage rewards check reference-action agreement, not the website's terminal state. Equivalent selectors, coordinates, action orders, keyboard shortcuts, and recovery paths make exact imitation an incomplete correctness criterion.

The synthetic rationale layer has separate epistemic risk. An unnamed VLM writes the rationale after seeing the task, history, current state, and recorded action. It can therefore produce a fluent post-hoc explanation that is not faithful to the human's decision process. The paper does not disclose the VLM, prompt, decoding settings, rejection criteria, or human validation rate, so rationale quality and contamination cannot be independently reproduced.

Privacy and rights remain material. Screenshots, DOM text, Accessibility trees, form fields, typed strings, account state, messages, addresses, search history, payment/shipping context, or session data may expose personal or confidential information. The paper says redaction and review were used and that no PII is released, but no per-record consent/redaction log or false-negative audit is published. The custom dataset license constrains recipients; it does not establish collection or redistribution permission for content from all 428 third-party sites. Site Terms of Service, robots/access policy, copyright, user consent, and authenticated-account provenance remain domain-specific unknowns.

Reproducibility is limited by live-site drift. DOM trees, page layout, localization, personalization, geolocation, authentication, APIs, inventory, and anti-bot behavior change over time. Selectors and coordinates can become stale even when the record was initially valid. Collection timestamps, browser and OS builds, viewport, locale, account state, archived pages, and replay diagnostics are not provided as a complete per-record manifest.

Release packaging has concrete gaps. Access is manually gated and limited by WebChain Academic Research License v1.0; it is not unrestricted open-source reuse. Full-page screenshots are only partially available, raw files need custom parsing, and no single schema spans every artifact. The HF quick-start points to computer-use-agent-Lab/WebChain, while the inspected repository is webagentlab/WebChain; the LICENSE footer names Fan-Sicheng/WebChain. The author-linked GitHub repository claims Apache-2.0 in its README but has no detected license file and no implementation code in its checked tree.

Finally, splits and provenance are incomplete. The release includes high/low test Parquet files and the paper describes a 1,200-step held-out benchmark, but deterministic split construction, deduplication, cross-benchmark decontamination, rejected traces, exact task/domain mixture, and immutable per-file checksums are not documented end to end. Reported benchmark improvements should therefore be treated as experiment evidence, not as proof that the dataset is uniformly correct or safe.

成功契约披露不足。“人工核验”没有说明 428 个 domain 上如何判断完成、如何处理分歧或失败尝试、是否由审查者逐条重放。实验中的 coordinate-in-box 与词汇覆盖 reward 只检查参考动作一致性，而非网站终局。等价 selector、坐标、动作顺序、键盘快捷方式与恢复路径的存在，也使精确模仿不能完整代表正确性。

合成解释层具有独立的认知风险。一个未具名 VLM 在看到任务、历史、当前状态和已记录动作之后编写解释，因此可能生成流畅但事后合理化的文本，并不忠实于人的决策过程。论文未披露 VLM、prompt、解码设置、拒绝标准和人工核验比例，解释质量及其污染风险无法独立复现。

隐私与权利问题仍然重要。截图、DOM 文本、Accessibility tree、表单字段、输入字符串、账户状态、消息、地址、搜索历史、支付/配送上下文或 session 数据都可能包含个人或机密信息。论文称已做脱敏和审查且不发布 PII，但没有逐记录同意/脱敏日志或漏检审计。自定义数据许可约束的是接收者，并不能证明对 428 个第三方网站的内容都具有采集与再发布权限；网站 ToS、robots/access policy、版权、用户同意和登录账户 provenance 仍是逐 domain 的 unknown。

真实网站漂移限制了可复现性。DOM、布局、本地化、个性化、地理位置、认证、API、库存和反机器人行为都会变化，即使记录最初有效，selector 与坐标也可能失效。采集时间、浏览器与 OS build、viewport、locale、账户状态、归档页面及重放诊断没有形成完整的逐记录 manifest。

发布包装也存在具体缺口。访问需要人工审批，且 WebChain Academic Research License v1.0 对用途有限制，因此不是不受限的 open-source 复用。全页面截图仅部分可用，原始文件需自定义解析，也没有覆盖全部 artifact 的统一 schema。HF quick-start 使用 computer-use-agent-Lab/WebChain，实际检查的仓库是 webagentlab/WebChain，LICENSE 末尾又写成 Fan-Sicheng/WebChain。作者链接的 GitHub README 声称 Apache-2.0，但 API 未检测到许可证，文件树中也没有 LICENSE 或实现代码。

最后，split 与 provenance 仍不完整。发布物包含 high/low test Parquet，论文也描述了 1,200 步 held-out benchmark，但没有端到端公开确定性的 split 构造、去重、跨 benchmark 去污染、拒绝轨迹、精确任务/domain 混合和逐文件不可变 checksum。因此，benchmark 提升只能作为实验结果，不能当作数据整体正确、安全的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the data-construction/open-release-recipes track, WebChain is useful as a worked example of turning live human interaction into two training views. The raw trajectory preserves episode context and multimodal state; low-level processed samples support element grounding and action localization; high-level samples support task-conditioned planning. The accepted uses are multimodal web-agent SFT and broader agent training, including controlled study of whether grounding initialization improves later planning.

The corpus can support action prediction, GUI grounding, trajectory modeling, long-horizon planning, and analyses of human versus synthetic state coverage. Its synchronized visual, structural, and action fields also make it suitable for studying representation choices: pixels alone, DOM/Accessibility alone, or joint grounding. Researchers can use the paper's reward contract as one reference-action metric, but outcome evaluation should independently inspect the terminal state and allow alternative valid actions.

A careful reuse workflow should request access under the actual academic license, pin the HF revision, inventory which modalities exist per record, and preserve domain/trajectory/step identifiers. Before training, users should scan screenshots, DOM, Accessibility text, and typed content for sensitive data; review source-site rights; separate human actions from synthetic rationales; and document any filtering or transformations. For replay, they should record browser, viewport, locale, time, account state, and page snapshot whenever legally and technically possible.

The release is also valuable as an audit case. It demonstrates that “data available” and “code available” are separate claims, that a visible HF page can still be gated, and that custom licensing and partial modalities materially affect reproducibility. These constraints should travel with downstream model and benchmark documentation rather than disappearing after ingestion.

在数据构造与开放发布配方 track 中，WebChain 是把真实人类交互转成两类训练视图的完整案例。原始轨迹保留 episode 上下文和多模态状态；低层加工样本面向元素 grounding 与动作定位；高层样本面向任务条件下的规划。已接受的用途是多模态网页 agent SFT 与更广义的 agent training，包括受控研究 grounding 初始化是否能改善后续规划。

该语料可用于动作预测、GUI grounding、轨迹建模、长程规划，以及比较人类与合成数据覆盖的状态分布。同步的视觉、结构和动作字段也适合研究表示选择：只用像素、只用 DOM/Accessibility，或联合 grounding。论文的 reward 契约可作为一种参考动作指标，但 outcome evaluation 应独立检查终局，并允许替代有效动作。

稳妥的复用流程应先按实际学术许可申请访问，固定 HF revision，盘点每条记录真正存在的 modality，并保留 domain/trajectory/step 标识。训练前要扫描截图、DOM、Accessibility 文本和输入内容中的敏感信息，审查来源网站权利，把人类动作与合成解释分开，并记录所有过滤和变换。若要重放，应在法律与技术允许时保存浏览器、viewport、locale、时间、账户状态和页面快照。

这个发布物本身也是有用的审计样本：它表明“数据可得”与“代码可得”是两项独立主张，公开可见的 HF 页面仍可能 gated，自定义许可和缺失 modality 会实质影响可复现性。这些限制应随下游模型卡和 benchmark 文档继续保留，而不能在数据摄取后消失。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the scale denominators separate: 31,725 trajectories, 317,993 steps, and 428 domains; “318K” is the abstract's rounded step count. Triple Alignment synchronizes visual context, HTML/Accessibility structure, and grounded action metadata, but full-page screenshots cover only part of the release.
  • Preserve provenance layers: task text is LLM-synthesized from a website functional schema, action trajectories are human-executed, and Chain-of-Thought-style rationales are generated by an unnamed VLM. “Human-annotated trajectory” does not mean every field is human-authored.
  • The step reward combines action-type and reference-content matching; coordinate-in-box and lexical coverage are not universal terminal-state verification. WebChainBench has 1,200 held-out steps.
  • WCB-L results for the 3B model are 0.487 direct LCRL, 0.603 with CoT-SFT, 0.629 with SGRL, and 0.658 with both. Treat these and the scaling results as training evidence, not as a data-quality certificate.
  • The HF artifact is manually gated under WebChain Academic Research License v1.0. Pin revision ae99f420a646866fd3f6d70ca5984efa0eca5a77; raw records need custom parsing, full modalities vary, and the quick-start namespace is inconsistent with the actual repository namespace.
  • The arXiv-linked GitHub repository was documentation-only when checked. Still unknown are generator/VLM identities and prompts, attempted/rejected counts, annotator and success-adjudication protocols, split/decontamination manifests, per-site rights review, and per-record privacy/replay metadata.

• 区分三个规模分母：31,725 条轨迹、317,993 个步骤、428 个 domain；摘要中的 318K 是步骤数的舍入值。Triple Alignment 同步视觉、HTML/Accessibility 结构与 grounded action，但全页面截图只覆盖部分记录。
  • 保持 provenance 分层：任务文本由 LLM 根据网站功能 schema 合成，动作轨迹由人执行，Chain-of-Thought 风格解释由未具名 VLM 生成；“人工标注轨迹”不等于所有字段都由人创作。
  • step reward 结合动作类型与参考内容匹配；coordinate-in-box 与词汇覆盖不是通用终局验证。WebChainBench 有 1,200 个 held-out 步骤。
  • 3B 模型的 WCB-L 结果为：直接 LCRL 0.487、加入 CoT-SFT 0.603、加入 SGRL 0.629、两者同时加入 0.658。它们与 scaling 结果都是训练证据，不是数据质量证书。
  • HF artifact 需要人工审批并采用 WebChain Academic Research License v1.0。应固定 revision ae99f420a646866fd3f6d70ca5984efa0eca5a77；原始记录需自定义解析、modality 覆盖不一，且 quick-start namespace 与实际仓库不一致。
  • arXiv 链接的 GitHub 仓库在检查时只有说明材料。生成器/VLM 身份与 prompt、尝试/拒绝数量、标注与成功裁决协议、split/去污染 manifest、逐网站权利审查及逐记录隐私/重放元数据仍为 unknown。

items: Reference-action imitation can penalize valid alternative selectors, coordinates, navigation orders, shortcuts, or recovery actions; one human path is not a unique gold plan.

Synthetic rationales may be plausible post-hoc explanations rather than faithful human reasoning; the generating VLM and quality-control procedure are undisclosed.
Live-site DOM, layout, authentication, geolocation, personalization, and API changes can stale coordinates and selectors and prevent exact replay.
